text_block_list.text:
One afternoon, I get a notification on my 
phone, so I take a look, and――
Horseshoes: found―!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Wait! Bakushin O-senpaaai―……!
(Thud!!)
――A tremendous crash assaulted my back!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah～! I apologize for the abruptness of 
my assault! Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Please forgive her! My senpai only did it 
because her righteous heart is burning to 
catch this criminal…!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
My classmate's horseshoe has been stolen! 
As the class president, I cannot turn a 
blind eye!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
The same thing is happening all over 
school… I, too, as a hero of justice, am 
pursuing the culprit!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Stealing horseshoes, that crow!
choice_data_list: Was I just mistaken for a crow…?
Was I just mistaken for a crow…?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no! Not at all! That phone, it 
looked like the stolen horseshoe…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Just now! Compleeetely! I forgot that the 
culprit was a crow!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Howeeeeever! Next time, without fail, I'll 
get the horseshoe back from that cro――
(Kaaaaack! Caaaw!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
There it is! A crow with a horseshoe in 
its mouth! This time, in the name of the 
class president, I shall capture you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: You can't escaaaaaape!!

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Horseshoes and… huh? This menko, the one I 
lost and was looking for…!

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Aahh!? There's my hoof hammer, too! It was 
just the crows' doing…! Thank goodness!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
That crow was the school's great thief! 
That's amazin', Bakushin O-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Fu-fu-fu! Isn't it!? This is――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The Bakushin-esque power of the class 
president!

text_block_list.name: Classmates
text_block_list.text:
As expected, Bakushi―n! That's our class 
president～～!

Sakura Bakushinoh's fame was further 
enhanced!

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Thanks, class president! For getting 
my horseshoe back!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Those crows were shakin' in their boots so 
bad, they must have changed their minds! 
Now we've successfully kept the peace at 
the school!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, no, this is nothing! With my superb 
swiftness, I can do this stuff without 
breaking a sweat!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Please do keep counting on me for anything 
at all, one thing after the other!

Sakura Bakushin O's class was excited by 
her success.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Whhaaaah―!? Being able to fly isn't 
fair―!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh… I missed. I should have polished 
up on my Bakushin more…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
However, if I simply give up like this, 
I'll ruin my reputation as class 
president! What should I do!
choice_data_list: We'll use traps to lure them out.

text_block_list.text:
Earlier, she said "I mistook a horseshoe 
for a cell phone." …Using what she said as 
a hint, I set up a phone as a decoy――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hiyaaaaah――!!

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Thanks, class president! For getting 
my horseshoe back!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Those crows were shakin' in their boots so 
bad, they must have changed their minds! 
Now we've successfully kept the peace at 
the school!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'd like to thank you, too! This has 
been a great learning experience!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Not only must I Bakushin… It's also quite 
necessary to work out a plan!

While she regretted that she couldn't 
solve the problem, she seemed to have made 
a new discovery.
